criteria.requirement: Implement schedule.policies.with_error_policy(job, *, max_failures=3, on_error=None) for configured jobs. Preserve its bound callback arguments and return the original Job. Suppress Exception from that callback only, increment job.consecutive_failures, notify optional (original_exception,count) once, and return CancelJob when consecutive failures reach the positive integer limit; otherwise let normal Job.run reschedule once. Success resets the count and preserves return/CancelJob. Do not catch BaseException, suppress handler errors, double-wrap a job, retry immediately, or change unwrapped jobs exception behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
